name: net_spawn_emission_hb750_late_birth_3p

[(peek(0x2A0F7DC,'f32',i),peek(0x2A0F830,'f32',i)) for i in range(3)]

all((saved['regions750'][i]['kind']=='BOX' and all(abs(saved['friends_local750'][i][j])<saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][j] for j in range(3))) or (saved['regions750'][i]['kind']=='CYLINDER' and abs(saved['friends_local750'][i][1])<saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][1] and sum((saved['friends_local750'][i][j]/saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][j])**2 for j in (0,2))<1) for i in (1,2))

steps.expr: not (all((saved['regions750'][i]['kind']=='BOX' and all(abs(saved['friends_local750'][i][j])<saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][j] for j in range(3))) or (saved['regions750'][i]['kind']=='CYLINDER' and abs(saved['friends_local750'][i][1])<saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][1] and sum((saved['friends_local750'][i][j]/saved['regions750'][i]['extents'][j])**2 for j in (0,2))<1) for i in (0,)))

steps.expr: [[(a['objectId'],a['hp'],a['address']) for a in enemies(i) if a['objectId']==2407 and a['hp']>0] for i in range(3)]

saved['late_birth750']['completed'] and saved['late_birth750']['resumedAll'] and saved['late_birth750']['friendEmittedBeforeDeath']=={'1':0,'2':0} and saved['late_birth750']['hostDeaths']==[int(saved['late_birth750']['hostTarget']['netId'])]

steps.expr: all(any(e['netId']==saved['late_birth750']['hostTarget']['netId'] and e['seq']==saved['late_birth750']['hostTarget']['seq'] and e['record']=='0' for e in log_matches('\\[spawn-emission\\] client emitted epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) key=(?P<key>\\d+) header=750 record=(?P<record>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+)',i)) and any(a['netId']==a['expected'] and a['netId']==saved['late_birth750']['hostTarget']['netId'] and a['seq']==saved['late_birth750']['hostTarget']['seq'] and a['objectId']=='2405' and a['terminal']=='1' for a in log_matches('\\[spawn-birth\\] adopted frame=(?P<frame>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) expected=(?P<expected>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+) actor=(?P<actor>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) objectId=(?P<objectId>\\d+) terminal=(?P<terminal>[01])',i)) for i in (1,2))

len(log_matches('\\[spawn-emission\\] sent epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+) key=(?P<key>\\d+) header=750 record=(?P<record>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) ',0))==5 and sorted(int(h['record']) for h in log_matches('\\[spawn-emission\\] sent epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+) key=(?P<key>\\d+) header=750 record=(?P<record>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) ',0))==[0,1,2,3,4] and len(set(h['netId'] for h in log_matches('\\[spawn-emission\\] sent epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+) key=(?P<key>\\d+) header=750 record=(?P<record>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) ',0)))==5
log_matches('\\[spawn-emission\\] sent epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+) key=(?P<key>\\d+) header=750 record=(?P<record>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) ',0)

all(all(any(e['netId']==h['netId'] and e['seq']==h['seq'] and e['record']==h['record'] for e in log_matches('\\[spawn-emission\\] client emitted epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) key=(?P<key>\\d+) header=750 record=(?P<record>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+)',i)) for h in saved['all_host750']) for i in (1,2))

all(len(enemy_hps(i))==0 for i in range(3))

{'pausedMs':saved['late_birth750']['pausedMs'],'hostLiveMs':saved['late_birth750']['hostLiveMs'],'hostTerminalPublishedMs':saved['late_birth750']['hostTerminalPublishedMs'],'target':saved['late_birth750']['hostTarget'],'friends':[{'instance':i,'consumed':len([e for e in log_matches('\\[spawn-emission\\] client emitted epoch=(?P<epoch>\\d+) key=(?P<key>\\d+) header=750 record=(?P<record>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+)',i) if any(e['netId']==h['netId'] and e['seq']==h['seq'] for h in saved['all_host750'])]),'terminalRecord0':len([a for a in log_matches('\\[spawn-birth\\] adopted frame=(?P<frame>\\d+) netId=(?P<netId>\\d+) expected=(?P<expected>\\d+) seq=(?P<seq>\\d+) actor=(?P<actor>[0-9A-Fa-f]+) objectId=(?P<objectId>\\d+) terminal=(?P<terminal>[01])',i) if a['netId']==a['expected'] and a['netId']==saved['late_birth750']['hostTarget']['netId'] and a['seq']==saved['late_birth750']['hostTarget']['seq'] and a['objectId']=='2405' and a['terminal']=='1']),'remainingBeforeClear':saved['late_birth_remaining']['instances'][str(i)]['count'],'living':len(enemy_hps(i)),'unmatched':saved['late_birth_empty']['instances'][str(i)]['unmatched']} for i in (1,2)]}
all(p['consumed']==5 and p['terminalRecord0']==1 and p['remainingBeforeClear']==4 and p['living']==0 and p['unmatched']==0 for p in saved['late_birth_metrics']['friends'])
